item.title: Comet C/2026 A1 to light up Earth’s sky
item.description: Comet C/2026 A1 (MAPS), which is on a collision course with the Sun, may become visible to the naked eye shortly before its dramatic demise, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan foils alleged IRGC terror plot targeting strategic infrastructure near Baku
item.description: Iranian citizen offered $50,000 to the person who would place an explosive device under the bridge in Azerbaijan's Sangachal, AzeNEWS reports, citing Trend.

item.title: S. Korea inflation stable in February
item.description: South Korea’s consumer prices increased by 2.0% in February compared with a year earlier, according to Statistics Korea, which released the data on Friday, AzerNEWS reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Corgis endanger in UK
item.description: The famous Corgi breed, long associated with the image of the late Queen Elizabeth II, may face an uncertain future in the United Kingdom, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Mideast crisis sparks energy windfall for South Caucasus and Central Asia
item.description: The war between Iran, Israel, and the United States extends beyond these three nations, posing wider implications for both the Middle East and the South Caucasus. These regions account for a critical share of global oil transportation in terms of both production and export. Amid growing instability in the Middle East, particularly the disruption of shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, global energy markets are increasingly looking for alternative sources and supply routes. item.title: New technology could transform recycling of polyethylene and polypropylen
item.description: Scientists at the University of Buffalo (USA) have developed an innovative method for recycling flexible plastics, which could significantly expand the possibilities for reusing the most common types of plastics—polyethylene (PE) and polypropylene (PP), AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan–UAE Parliamentary leaders discuss regional tensions and stress respect for sovereignty
item.description: During the conversation, the speakers expressed serious concern over what they described as unjustified attacks carried out by the Islamic Republic of Iran against the territories and civilian populations of both countries. They strongly condemned such actions.

item.title: Azeri Light oil rises above $90 in Ceyhan, Brent nears $95
item.description: The price of Azerbaijani Azeri Light crude oil on a CIF basis at the Port of Augusta increased by $6.72 or 7.64% compared to the previous indicator, reaching $94.62 per barrel, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: President Ilham Aliyev expresses gratitude to President of Kazakhstan for his support
item.description: President of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev expressed his gratitude to the President of Kazakhstan, Kassym-Jomart Tokayev, for his post on X supporting Azerbaijan following Iran’s drone strike on Azerbaijan’s Nakhchivan.

item.title: President Ilham Aliyev expresses gratitude to Slovak President for principled position and solidarity
item.description: President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev expressed gratitude to President of Slovakia Peter Pellegrini for his principled position and solidarity following Iran's drone attacks on Nakhchivan, AzerNEWS reports.
